meta.source: Conference-best bars from the 2026 FBS pool incumbents in teams.json (qualified rooms only); getable lists are the depth-test candidates under the path replacement doctrine (benchmark beats the room's lowest-graded man, snaps aside, or slots in above an ungraded bottom man) joined to players.json eligibility (elig_qualified).
meta.snapshot: Pool is a Nov 17, 2026 in-season snapshot of PFF Ultimate exports.
meta.bar_note: The conference-best standard at a group is the highest volume-qualified incumbent grade at that group among the teams in the conference. A room carried below the volume bar never sets the standard. If no team in the conference has a qualified incumbent at the group, the standard is the best qualified incumbent grade at the team's level (G6 or P4) and bar_scope reads "level".
meta.getable_note: Getable = an evaluated player with eligibility remaining under the qualified determination (Unsettled players are included and flagged), whose fits benchmark (headline grade + the position translation delta) beats the lowest-graded man in the room — the path replacement doctrine (Tommy, Nov 19, 2026): the path works from the bottom of the room up toward its median, and the bottom player is replaceable whatever his snap count, so the zero-volume tail counts and a man with no grade on record is the first to fall off; a player who slots into the room only above an ungraded bottom man carries depth_ungraded=True and no point-worth is claimed for that pairing — and who is not already on the team. A getable entry with starter=True also beats the room's top man — the qualified incumbent's grade where the room has one, else the highest grade among its played men — the old strict test kept as the flagged top tier. Rooms carried below the volume bar name getable players under the depth test (their bottom man is the bar); a room with no rostered man in the snapshot names nobody. Getable is a field test — it does not price the player; each getable player separately carries his estimated NIL projection from the NIL layer where priced (nil_floor / nil_ceiling), or an explicit no-estimate status.
meta.nil_label: Estimated NIL projection — modelled from reported market bands [and On3's published valuation where shown]. Not a reported deal or an offer for this player.
meta.roster_note: Each room also carries its full 2026 roster from the pool (every player with volume at the group, best grade first) — the room a transfer would be entering, not just its top man.
meta.avail_note: avail lists every evaluated player with eligibility remaining and a projection benchmark, by group: up-side players at their book fits benchmark, down-side (P4 Down) players at their projected G6 grade, offered to G6 teams only. Slot-in standing on the page ranks a player's benchmark against the destination room's full roster grades.
